newsitem.title: UK: DTI watching BT, MCI merger talks.
newsitem.headline: DTI watching BT, MCI merger talks.

text.p: Britain's Trade and Industry Department (DTI) said it was too soon to say what regulatory hurdles any merger between British Telecommunications Plc and MCI Communications Corp of the U.S. would have to overcome.
The two companies were in talks over the weekend on what BT described as a possible "strategic merger." An announcement is expected in time for the reopening of stock markets on Monday.

"These talks are a matter for the companies, but we understand that the companies have been in discussions. The structure of any agreement eventually reached will determine its treatment under competition regimes," a DTI spokesman said.
